description: Free up to 300 calls/day per client (a pass lifts the cap). Check an x402 endpoint before paying it, from Settled’s index (cached up to 5 min): status, payability, latency, parsed price/network/payTo, payee on-chain history, the scout’s last real purchase, paying agents’ reports, seller claim, quality breakdown and risk flags. Use when: deciding whether to call an endpoint, and for routine re-checks. Not for: a fresh probe right now (settled_preflight) or searching (settled_find_endpoints). If status is unknown, call settled_submit; after paying, call settled_report.

force.description: true to probe now instead of using the 5-minute cache; needs a pass

pass.description: Settled day pass token: lifts the free daily cap; or send it as the x-settled-pass header

url.description: Full URL of the x402 endpoint, e.g. https://api.example.com/search

name: settled_check

attestation.description: EIP-191 signature over the answer; verify it with settled_verify or any EVM library

cached.description: Whether this came from Settled's 5-minute cache

delivery_receipt.description: The scout's last purchase, with its settlement transaction and checks (when the scout has bought it)

delivery_verified.description: Whether a real payment by Settled's scout came back with content

error.description: Present only when the call failed or needs another step: an error code such as pass_required, next to the fields that explain it

http_status_last.description: HTTP status of the latest probe

last_delivery_at.description: When the scout last bought it

last_ok_at.description: When it last answered with a valid quote

onchain.description: Settlements and unique payers over the last 30 days

pay_to.description: The payTo Settled's probe sees; compare it with the quote you are about to pay

payability.description: Payability verdict and the verb that pays

payee.description: Whether the payTo has on-chain history

price_usd.description: Price per call in USD (cheapest option)

seller_claim.description: The seller's claim and profile, if claimed

status.description: Endpoint status, e.g. live, degraded, dead, free, auth_gated, not_found or quote_invalid

title: Check an x402 endpoint
